QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] A Test-tube Devil
QuestInfo.0: You and Crow have to work together, but he's very bitter about your joining the Silent Crusade. Be patient and try talking to him again.
QuestInfo.1: Enter the Mystic Gate, eliminate the monsters, and make Crow eat some humble pie.
QuestInfo.2: You eradicated the beefy #o9300879# but Crow is still being a pain. One more mission might make him see the light.

0.0: I didn't join the Silent Crusade to watch after some half-wit kid with a non-existent sense of self-preservation. If you're so great, go down and check out the Mystic Gate on your own.

yes.0: Good, I wouldn't want to have to spend that much time with you anyway. I'd probably have to save your hide and then we'd go on some stupid buddy-buddy bonding mission. Bleh. Let's go over what we have. It seems like monsters around here are similar to the one in Nihal Desert. I'm pretty sure that's the Mystic Gates. Didn't Deo and #o9300878# look stronger to you? Take a trip into the Gate here and tell me what you find.

no.0: I knew you weren't ready. Come back when you're ready to play with the big boys.

1.0: Oh, you lived. How was it?\r\n#L0##bNothing suspicious. Not that I'd tell you if there was.#l\n#k
1.1: Ha, like you could outwit me. The monster was stronger, different, wasn't he? I could tell by that misguided limp you call a swagger. Don't pat yourself on the back for doing a job any of us could take care of.\r\n#L0##bI'm not patting myself on the back! I just did my job as a member of the Silent Crusade!#l\n#k
1.2: For most Crusaders, this is a warmup before breakfast. Heck, for some of us it IS breakfast! The real deal begins now, so listen up!\r\n#L0##bWill you just stop talking already? I got this.#l\n#k
1.3: Hmph. Feel free to dial down the attitude, champ. Put a sock in it and pay attention, so I can tell you where the next Mystic Gate is.

mob.0: Enter the Mystic Gate, and see if the monsters look weird before you obliterate them.
